registration_scope: C15 mathematical exclusion screen; new population bounds only if independently certified; analytic reference numbers already derived, not prospectively validated
hypothesis: For the frozen WEAK lognormal eight-step process, long-only predictable self-financed inventory has expected drift increment at most gamma times expected pre-substep dollar inventory. Separately bounded positive execution credits U and lower-bounded trading/calendar costs yield E log(W_T/W_0)/176 <= log(1+(gamma*A+U-Cstar)/20000)/176 by Jensen. A and U unknown means no mathematical exclusion can be certified. A tested fixture is not a population expectation.

quantities.A: E_WEAK sum over all intraday ticks and both assets of q_t * S_t; q_t predictably held before price innovation; includes positions spanning windows
quantities.U: E_WEAK sum positive execution-price credits vs time-aligned actually attainable substep reference; OHLC-high does not prove U=0
quantities.Cstar: provable lower sum cash calendar charges plus nonnegative accrued commission/slippage actually accounted

theorem: E_WEAK log(W_T/W_0)/D <= log(1+(gamma*A+U-Cstar)/W0)/D, gamma=expm1(0.000025*1.1/8), provided W_T>0, q long/nonnegative and predictable, all self-financing cash flows represented, conditional compensated Gaussian innovations, mean-one overnight jumps, and every receipt processed no earlier than knownAt.
necessary_exclusion: If gamma*A_upper + U_upper - C_lower < W0*expm1(D*h), the WEAK nominal mean cannot reach original hurdle, conditional on independently verified bounds. The reverse inequality does not prove GO.
